headline: EuroHPC updates AI Gigafactories tender deadlines and invalidates existing submissions
summary: EuroHPC’s AI Gigafactories tender page, updated 5 November 2026, says a technical issue invalidates all draft and submitted tenders in the system for both lots; replacement submission links are forthcoming, and applicants are told not to continue current drafts. The page retains deadlines of 4 February 2027 for Lot 1 and 3 December 2026 for Lot 2. The prior Lot 1 extension was publicly reported by the Czech ministry on 26 October to allow Member States time for national budget procedures and financial commitments. This is a change to the procurement process; it establishes no consortium awards, committed investment, facility construction, operating compute or access.
